Subject: Project Timeline Update: New Delivery Date

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to share an update on the project timeline. Certifying the third-party integration has taken longer than expected, and as a result the delivery date has moved by two weeks. We are continuing to work through the remaining steps with the vendor to keep things on track from here.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team remains focused on the outstanding certification requirements and will keep you informed as we approach this milestone, including any interim checkpoints that would be useful to review together.

Would the new date of 14 April still work well with your internal planning and any dependent milestones on your end? Please let us know if you'd like to schedule a call to walk through the revised plan in more detail, and thank you for your continued partnership on this project.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
